seoTitle: Race Time Predictor (Riegel Formula for 5K to Marathon)
metaDescription: Predict 5K, 10K, half marathon and marathon times from a recent race result with the Riegel formula, with the pace for each distance.
intro: Predict your 5K, 10K, half marathon and marathon times.
why:
Enter a recent race distance and finish time. The page applies the Riegel formula, T2 = T1 x (D2 / D1) raised to 1.06, and lists predicted times and paces for the other distances.

The formula assumes you have trained for the longer race. For a marathon predicted from a 5K, treat the result as an upper limit of what you could do with solid mileage. You can change the exponent if you know a better one for yourself.
howTo: Enter your recent race distance and time.
Keep 1.06 or set your own exponent.
Read the predicted times and paces.

faq.a: It works best between about 5K and the half marathon for trained runners. Errors grow towards the marathon.

faq.q: Why is my marathon prediction too fast?
faq.a: Short races do not show how well you handle fatigue over 3 hours. Low weekly mileage is the usual reason.
